exam.title: Microsoft Azure Administrator
exam.study_prerequisites: Azure fundamentals plus practical operating-system, networking, server, virtualization, PowerShell or Azure CLI, Resource Manager or Bicep, and Microsoft Entra ID experience.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Deploy and manage Azure compute resources

review.notes: All five weighted objective groups and their April 17, 2026 bullets are mapped to scope and control-plane mental models, operational decision tables, failure modes, two integrated scenarios, eight independent labs, and 20 original knowledge checks. All 25 cited URLs are exact source-catalog entries. Two O'Reilly pages and one Udemy page returned HTTP 403 to the automated monitor and are treated as access-blocked rather than missing. Licensing, supported regions and SKUs, limits, policy and platform behaviors, recovery windows, networking support, and portal surfaces are explicitly marked VERIFY CURRENT.

findings.title: License membership changes require effective-state checks
findings.evidence: Current procedure excludes nested groups and verifies destination assignment before removal.
findings.recommendation: Add safe transition and feature-specific membership boundary.
findings.resolution: Add safe transition and feature-specific membership boundary.

findings.title: Legacy SSPR method settings are no longer current
findings.evidence: Authentication methods policy replaces legacy management from September 30, 2025.
findings.recommendation: Update method policy, scope and non-admin validation.
findings.resolution: Update method policy, scope and non-admin validation.

findings.title: Role exclusions are not explicit denies
findings.evidence: NotActions subtracts locally and other roles can grant; deny assignments differ.

findings.title: Replication has prerequisite and destination-write limits
findings.evidence: Source change feed, bilateral versioning, matching rules and destination constraints.
findings.recommendation: Add configuration/verification checklist and separate backup.
findings.resolution: Add configuration/verification checklist and separate backup.

findings.title: Undelete with versioning does not restore the current blob
findings.evidence: Promote a chosen version; retention and container/account protection differ.
findings.recommendation: Add original version timeline and correct lab recovery step.
findings.resolution: Add original version timeline and correct lab recovery step.

findings.title: Lifecycle policy changes do not execute immediately
findings.evidence: Periodic execution and running-policy behavior; archive rehydration unsupported.
findings.recommendation: Add timing, filter, whole-policy and recovery boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add timing, filter, whole-policy and recovery boundaries.

findings.title: Incremental resources do not imply incremental properties
findings.evidence: Declared resource configuration is reapplied; omitted properties can reset.
findings.recommendation: Add property/resource distinction and current deletion direction.
findings.resolution: Add property/resource distinction and current deletion direction.

findings.title: Disk encryption at host is not a running-guest isolation guarantee
findings.evidence: Host data/caches and encrypted disk path with explicit eligibility/deallocation limits.
findings.recommendation: Correct table wording and configuration caveats.
findings.resolution: Correct table wording and configuration caveats.

findings.title: Registry roles depend on permission mode
findings.evidence: Legacy AcrPull/AcrPush/AcrDelete not honored in ABAC-enabled mode.

findings.title: Swap does not move every dependency
findings.evidence: Managed identity and VNet integration remain with slots; endpoints not cloned.
findings.recommendation: Add per-slot validation and database/worker limitations.
findings.resolution: Add per-slot validation and database/worker limitations.

findings.title: Automatic certificate management has external-consumer and validation limits
findings.evidence: ASC 198-day issuance/validation window; exported copies and pending validation require action.
findings.recommendation: Add inventory exercise and current certificate-type-specific guidance.
findings.resolution: Add inventory exercise and current certificate-type-specific guidance.

findings.title: App backup does not imply database recovery
findings.evidence: Different backup limits/authentication, Flexible Server exclusion and 2028 linked-backup deadline.
findings.recommendation: Add app/database recovery split and follow-up.
findings.resolution: Add app/database recovery split and follow-up.

findings.title: Private subnet default scope is API- and VNet-dependent
findings.evidence: New VNet APIs after March 31, 2026 require explicit egress; existing VNets unchanged.
findings.recommendation: Add actual-setting verification and qualify old blog/public-IP prose.
findings.resolution: Add actual-setting verification and qualify old blog/public-IP prose.

findings.title: Legacy network labs include unavailable features
findings.evidence: New NSG flow logs unavailable and retire in 2027; current LB/PIP references retire Basic SKUs.
findings.recommendation: Use supported network labs and preserve record-retention distinction.
findings.resolution: Use supported network labs and preserve record-retention distinction.

findings.title: Installed agent does not prove guest-data coverage
findings.evidence: Associated DCRs define data and destination.
findings.recommendation: Add ingestion fixture/coverage and event-versus-operation example.
findings.resolution: Add ingestion fixture/coverage and event-versus-operation example.

findings.title: Retention can outlast fixed immutability
findings.evidence: Fixed duration in supported Recovery Services vaults differs from policy retention.
findings.recommendation: Add retention-window example, irreversible lock and WORM-scope boundary.
findings.resolution: Add retention-window example, irreversible lock and WORM-scope boundary.

findings.title: A completed failover is not validated service recovery
findings.evidence: Recovery-point choices and isolated drill/cleanup have distinct responsibilities.
findings.recommendation: Add RPO/RTO arithmetic and application validation.
findings.resolution: Add RPO/RTO arithmetic and application validation.
